camera.orientation: camera is above +Z and looks straight down -Z; head/forward +X projects toward token top; tail/rear projects toward token bottom
camera.framing: fixed scale with ground origin at token [50,60]
camera.depthOrder: far-to-near camera depth; higher +Z surfaces render nearer; stable semantic-id tie break

idleA.motionSemantics: alert mountain-goat breathing, neck counter-motion and ear/tail movement above four fixed hooves

walkA.motionSemantics: baked sagittal IK; shoulder/hip swing, elbow/stifle flexion, opposing hind hock; planted stance and raised swing

attack.motionSemantics: authored braced mountain-goat head-butt: load neck, tuck forehead and thrust suddenly, brief contact and recoil, recover; Goat ram-run informs tucked charging posture, not a literal native impact retarget

profile.silhouette: compact mountain goat: deep chest, sturdy short lower legs, narrow head/muzzle, upright-outward ears, short tail and narrow swept-back horns
profile.locomotion: careful four-beat walk and agile gallop with articulated carpi, stifles and hocks
profile.attack: authored braced head-butt: recoil, tuck forehead, sudden head-driven thrust, recoil and recover; domestic Goat ram-run informs the charging posture
